Technical Writer Intern, Developer Experience (Summer 2027)

San Francisco

About The Developer Experience Team

The Developer Experience (DevX) team owns how developers learn and build on Together AI. We run the documentation site, API reference, quickstarts, cookbooks, and the tooling that keeps all of it accurate as the platform ships new models and features every week.

We treat docs as a product and as code. Content lives in Git, publishes through Mintlify, and stays in sync with the API through CI/CD automation built on GitHub Actions. We also write for two audiences at once: the human developer reading a guide, and the AI coding agent pulling our docs into its context window. That means a house style guide built for AI-assisted authoring, structured content agents can parse, and automated review passes that check drafts against our quality bar.

Role Overview

As a Technical Writer Intern on DevX, you will write, test, and ship documentation that thousands of developers use to build with open-weight models. You'll be paired with a DevX mentor and own significant projects end to end, from scoping through launch, with real users and real metrics at the finish line.

This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll run the code you document, call our APIs, and open pull requests against the docs repo from your first week.

Potential Projects Include



- Build a closed-to-open migration kit
- Make a docs section agent-ready, and prove it
- Generate the CLI reference from source
- Write an evaluation design tutorial series

Responsibilities



- Write clear, accurate guides, tutorials, and reference content for Together AI's inference, fine-tuning, and GPU cluster products.
- Work with engineers, product managers, and researchers to understand new features well enough to explain them simply.
- Use AI tools in your daily workflow, and help us improve how we use them for drafting, editorial review, and publishing.
- Test every feature you document by running the code yourself, and file bugs when the product or the docs don't behave as expected.
- Draft, review, and publish in a docs-as-code workflow: Git, pull requests, code review, and Mintlify.
- Contribute to release notes and changelog entries as features launch.
- Use page analytics, search data, and developer feedback to decide what to improve next.

Qualifications



- Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's program in Computer Science, Technical Communication, or a related field, graduating December 2027 or later.
- Exceptional written communication: you can make a complex technical idea clear and approachable.
- Working knowledge of at least one programming language (Python or TypeScript preferred) and comfort with Git source control.
- Curiosity about how developers learn, and how AI is changing the way they do it.

Nice to have



- Experience calling an LLM API or building a small project with AI tools.
- Familiarity with Markdown/MDX, static site generators, or docs platforms like Mintlify or Docusaurus.
- Experience with CI tools such as GitHub Actions.

Writing sample

Your Application Should Include One Or Two Writing Samples, Representing What You Think Is Your Own Best Work. The Subject Doesn’t Have To Be Technical, Or Even Nonfiction—though Both Are a Plus! For Example



- A technical blog post.
- A README, tutorial, or contribution to open-source docs.
- A research paper.
- A personal essay.
- A school newspaper submission.

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

Internship Program Details

Our internship program runs 12 to 14 weeks, giving you the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading engineers and researchers across multiple teams. This cohort's internship dates span either May 17th to August 6th or June 14th to September 3rd.

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation, housing stipends, and other competitive benefits. The estimated US hourly rate for this role is $41 a hour. Our hourly rates are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

Equal Opportunity

Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

 Shape the Future of Mobility at Nissan: Launch Your Career, Drive Innovation

 We are currently looking for a SAP Platform Intern (Finance/Purchasing) to join our team in Franklin, TN. The SAP Platform team supports the technology and business processes that enable key Nissan operations across supply chain, procurement, finance, and manufacturing. This internship offers hands-on experience working alongside experienced professionals on business, technology, and project-related initiatives. We're looking for curious, collaborative, and motivated students who are eager to learn, solve problems, and grow their skills in a dynamic team environment.

 A Day in the Life:
 
• Document current-state business processes in preparation for Nissan's SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA transformation. 
• Support project management and PMO activities, including status tracking, meeting coordination, and project documentation. 
• Assist with business process analysis and continuous improvement initiatives. 
• Collaborate with business and technology teams to develop and maintain project artifacts and process documentation. 
• Support reporting, data analysis, and knowledge management activities across Finance and Purchasing functions. 
 Who We’re Looking For :
 Required: 
 
• Must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program in Information Systems, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, or a related field. 
• Students entering their Junior, Senior, or Master's program at the start of the upcoming academic term. 
• Strong communication and documentation skills. 
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities. 
• Strong organizational skills with keen attention to detail. 
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Visio. 
• Eagerness to learn new technologies, business processes, and project management methodologies. 
• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment. 
• GPA of 3.0 or above (Candidates will be required to provide an official or unofficial transcript during the application process for verification.) 
• Ability to perform work onsite at Franklin, TN. 
 What You’ll Look Forward to at Nissan: 
 Connection and Collaboration: We offer Business Synergy Teams (ERGs) and opportunities for our employees to strengthen their relationships and meet people from similar and diverse backgrounds to foster a culture of belonging.

 Professional Training and Development: Expand your knowledge and skills through Nissan’s rich innovation offerings, seminars, learning platforms and leadership trainings.

 Nissan is committed to a drug-free workplace. All employment is contingent upon the successful completion of drug and background screenings in accordance with Nissan policies and in compliance with federal, state, and local laws, including the California Fair Chance Act and the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance. Nissan will consider qualified candidates with arrest or conviction records for employment in a manner consistent with these laws. 

 It is Nissan’s policy to provide Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, gender, military status, disability, or any other status protected by law. Candidates for this position must be legally authorized to work in the United States and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility at the time of hire; Nissan uses E-Verify to validate employment eligibility. 

 NISSAN FOR EVERYONE 

 People are our most valuable assets, and Nissan seeks to maximize the power of each individual member of our team. When everyone belongs, the power of NISSAN is undeniable. Nissan aims to improve business results through a workplace and business that meets the needs of our employees and customer base.

 Nissan is committed to creating a culture where everyone belongs and employees, customers, and partners feel respected, valued, and heard. We have Business Synergy Teams (BSTs) across the Americas that are open to all employees and seek to connect employees through common interests and foster a company culture where all employees feel supported and included.

 Nissan also values inclusion in our business as we respect and recognize the diversity of our customer base and the communities where we do business. We are committed to procuring innovative goods and services, retailing our products, and communicating from a position that will help us continue to offer our customers competitively designed, market-driven products.

 Join us as we carry our commitment to our employees and customers into the future.

 Who are our employees? 
 
 We’re an eclectic group of 5,000+ dreamers, believers and builders, operating in over 40 countries. We’re Hungry. Humble. Honest. With Heart. The 4H’s: these are our core values and the DNA of our company. They help drive our employees to succeed, to strive to be better, to learn from every experience. Our employees are encouraged to have spirited debates and conversations and to think with a founder’s mindset. This means we’re all CEO’s of the company and, as such, make the best decision every day that aligns with our company goals. It’s through our values, our conversations and mindsets that we can continue to disrupt the industry and drive innovation in the market.
 
 Who are we in the market? 
 
 Nutanix is a global leader in cloud software and hyperconverged infrastructure solutions, making infrastructure invisible so that IT can focus on the applications and services that power their business. Companies around the world use Nutanix Enterprise Cloud OS software to bring one-click application management and mobility across public, private and distributed edge clouds so they can run any application at any scale with a dramatically lower total cost of ownership. The result is organizations that can rapidly deliver a high-performance IT environment on demand, giving application owners a true cloud-like experience. Learn more about our products at www.nutanix.com or follow us on Twitter @Nutanix .

 Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart 
 Co-Op Program Details 
 
• Full-time co-op placement 
 
• 4-month term; Running January to April 2027 
 
• Located in Vancouver, BC 
 
• Opportunities to participate in intern and co-op events, networking sessions, and professional development activities 

 The Opportunity 
 If you’re early in your software development journey and ready to build software that runs at real-world scale, this is that kind of opportunity. As a co-op student, you'll gain hands-on industry experience while applying concepts from your coursework to real-world technical challenges. You'll work alongside experienced developers who will mentor and support your growth throughout your placement. 
 You won’t be observing from the sidelines. You’ll be learning by doing, contributing to infrastructure that runs in production at scale. 
 We have multiple Software Development Co-op opportunities in Vancouver for students seeking a work-integrated learning experience as part of their degree program. 
 About the Team 
 You will be part of our brand-new Vancouver R&D site, helping shape our Research and Development (R&D) culture as we grow. Teams establishing a footprint include those focused on: 
 
• Kubernetes-based enterprise platforms 
 
• Networking and security solutions 
 
• Distributed systems 
 
• Emerging AI capabilities 

 We partner closely across Software Development, Quality Testing, Technical Support, and Product teams. The technical depth is real. The standards are high. The collaboration is constant. 
 We value developers who think critically, communicate clearly, and care about the impact of their work. Let’s build what’s next, together. 
 What You’ll Learn 
 
• How enterprise software is designed, developed, and deployed 
 
• Modern software development practices including Agile methodologies and code reviews 
 
• Collaboration across Development, Product Management, and Technical Support 
 
• Cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, and automation frameworks 
 
• Professional skills including technical communication, problem solving, and stakeholder collaboration 
 What You Will Bring 
 
• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's degree program in Computer Science, Software Development, Computer Engineering, or a related field and eligible to participate in a co-op or internship program through your university 
 
• Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms 
 
• Experience with at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C++, Go, JavaScript). 
 
• Coursework, personal projects, hackathons, research, or other hands-on experience related to software development are considered an asset 
 
• Familiarity with version control systems such as Git 
 
• Exposure to software development lifecycle principles is a plus 
 
• Clear written and verbal communication skills in English 
 
• Curiosity, ownership mindset, and strong desire to grow 

 Whether you've built projects in class, participated in hackathons, contributed to open-source software, or simply love solving technical problems, we'd love to hear from you. At Nutanix, you'll have the opportunity to learn from experienced developers while making meaningful contributions to products used by customers around the world. 
 Work Arrangement 
 On Site: This role is based on-site, offering the opportunity to collaborate face-to-face with team members in a dynamic and engaging work environment. Being physically present allows for seamless teamwork and direct access to resources that support your success. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager. 
 Note: Nutanix does not assist with applications for work permits or permanent residence, including provincial nomination. 
 The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between CAD $ 30 and CAD $ 35 per hour. 
 However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. 
 If hired, employee will be in an "at-will position" and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. The posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.
